intentComment: Stories 082-088 + 091 + 092 + 094 - MAINNET StableStaker V1 -> V2 CUTOVER with Antimatter (script/CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet.s.sol; full detail in its NatSpec). One resumable, state-gated run, broadcast in TWO LEGS since story 094 (see Phase 6b). Phase 0 preconditions (owners, pausers, strategy map + strategy Pauser registration, PhusdStableMinter registration, phUSD minter baseline). Phase 1 retires V1: setPauser(OWNER) -> Pauser.unregister(V1) -> pause(); V1 is LEFT PAUSED, pauser OWNER, UNREGISTERED from the global Pauser for good (story 084). Phase 2 deploys Antimatter (name Antimatter, symbol AM) owned by 0xCad1..D0B6 and wires phUSD + PhusdStableMinter. Phase 3 deploys StableStakerV2 and pauses it (pauser OWNER, not registered) before any addToken. Phase 3b (story 091) deploys V2's DOLA DESTINATION: preflight sDOLA 0xb45ad160634c528Cc3D2926d9807104FA3157305 asset() == DOLA and maxDeposit >= V1's DOLA principal; new ERC4626YieldStrategy(OWNER, DOLA, sDOLA), its address persisted in the progress file as contracts.ERC4626YieldStrategySDOLA and recovered on resume (FAILS CLOSED, never deploys a second one, if the file names none while V2 already routes DOLA to a strategy or a Pauser registrant is such a strategy); setPauser(Pauser) -> Pauser.register (unpaused, before any V2 deposit) -> setWithdrawer(StableYieldAccumulator). Minter client wiring, SYA repoint and retiring the autoDOLA strategy are Phase 6b (story 092), in the same run. Halts in 3b expose nothing (the strategy has no client or principal until Phase 4). STRATEGY MAP SPLIT: V1 exits through the hard-coded SOURCE strategies (DOLA autoDOLA 0x1760..., USDC 0xaFDf..., USDe 0xaC2e...); V2 deposits into the DESTINATION (DOLA -> the sDOLA strategy; USDC / USDe unchanged). Phase 4 per V1 token (read live off V1.getStakedTokens), on the destination (must be Pauser-registered): addToken / setClient / idle-balance guard / setYieldStrategy / set-aside buffer pct copied from V1's source / antimatterPerDay = V1 phusdPerSecond*86400*21/10. Phase 5 grants V2 Antimatter mint, V2 phUSD mint and Antimatter phUSD mint (autoAnnihilate is V2's only reward path while claimEnabled is false), with a two-sided phUSD minter-set delta. Phase 6 CrossVersionMigrator + setMigrator both sides; per token relinquish the story-060 principal surplus, initiateMigration, plan every live staker with the dust predicate (credit==0 rides a batch; a credit that cannot deposit into V2 is a named straggler under a 1-cent cap, else STOP AND REPORT), batch-migrate (25 per call, strict-progress guard), post-conditions: per-user loss <= source bps + destination bps + 1000 wei, the bound counted ONCE when source == destination (story 091): 10 bps on DOLA (autoDOLA exit 5 + sDOLA entry 5), 5 bps (story 088; was 2) on USDC and 61 bps (2*30+1) on USDe; V2 totalStaked == sum of V2 stakers; lockstep strategy principal >= V2 booked; and the EXIT-REALIZATION BOUND min(R,P) + 1000 wei >= P * (1 - bps) on V1's immutable migrationInfo (story 087, audit-33 L-06) using the SOURCE bound, which a permissionless V1.userMigrate self-exit cannot move. Phase 6b (story 092, AFTER Phase 6 - ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: the source's totalWithdrawal redeems pro-rata of ALL its shares, so V1 must be drained first; the phase requires V1's autoDOLA principal == 0): record the PhusdStableMinter's DOLA exchangeRate / decimals / enabled / maxMintPerDay into the progress file (minterMove), setStablecoinEnabled(DOLA, false), EXECUTE the minter's delayed totalWithdrawal(DOLA, minter) on the autoDOLA strategy (DOLA R lands on OWNER; P - R <= P * 5 bps + 1000 wei; P, OWNER's pre-execution DOLA and R persisted, R re-derived on chain on resume, fail closed if unrecoverable). TWO-LEG FLOW (story 094, audit-35 L-09): a BROADCAST that executes ENDS ITS LEG right there with progress status awaiting_reseed, because forge's local pass computes R before the execute mines at the live autoDOLA price (a signed R could strand dust on OWNER or revert noMintDeposit); once the execute has mined, run :preview then :broadcast again and leg 2 re-seeds the MINED R and finishes (preview rehearses both legs in one pass and logs where the broadcast stops). Leg 2: sDOLA strategy setClient(minter) + minter approveYS, OWNER approve ceil(1.5 * R) (only when OWNER's allowance to the minter is below R; the ~0.5R headroom is left, harmless because noMintDeposit is onlyOwner and pulls from msg.sender) + minter.noMintDeposit(sDOLA strategy, DOLA, R) (OWNER's DOLA back to its pre-execution level), registerStablecoin(DOLA, sDOLA strategy, same rate, same decimals) -> setMaxMintPerDay(previous; registration resets it to 0 for ONE tx) -> restore enabled, SYA addYieldStrategy(sDOLA strategy) + removeYieldStrategy(autoDOLA strategy), autoDOLA setWithdrawer(SYA, false), autoDOLA setClient(V1 / minter, false), then the story-084 rule on the autoDOLA strategy: setPauser(OWNER) -> Pauser.unregister -> pause (the ONE tx between setPauser and unregister is the session's SECOND global-pause dead window - never walk away from a halt there: resume, or OWNER Pauser.unregister(0x1760...)). Phase 7 finalize: buffer recipient -> V2 on the destination (the autoDOLA source keeps recipient V1), revoke V1 phUSD mint, V1 retirement backstop, then V2 setPauser(Pauser) -> V2 UNPAUSE -> Pauser.register(V2) -> Antimatter setPauser(Pauser) -> Pauser.register(Antimatter) - V2 is unpaused BEFORE it is registered (story 087, audit-33 L-05); claimEnabled stays false. HALT CAVEAT (story 088): halted after the V2 unpause (before its register), or after the Antimatter setPauser (before its register), that one contract is unpaused, pauser already Pauser, UNREGISTERED - a global Pauser.pause() succeeds but MISSES it. V2 exposes nothing (every strategy V2 routes through is Pauser-registered - sDOLA strategy by Phase 3b, USDC/USDe asserted in Phase 0 - and every V2 user action reverts under a strategy pause). REMEDY: OWNER calling pause() directly REVERTS (onlyPauser); run setPauser(OWNER) then pause() on that contract (or OWNER Pauser.register(<contract>) then global pause). After setPauser(OWNER) on V2 a resume re-runs Phase 7 and UNPAUSES V2 - do not resume until the incident is cleared. Phase 8 wiring assertions incl. a sweep that every Pauser registrant is unpaused with pauser == Pauser (the retired autoDOLA strategy must NOT be a registrant) and story 092's end state: minter DOLA registration == sDOLA strategy with the previous rate / decimals / maxMintPerDay / enabled, minter principal on it within bound of R, SYA list +sDOLA -autoDOLA, SYA withdrawer only on the sDOLA strategy, autoDOLA strategy with no clients, no principal, pauser OWNER, unregistered, paused. Broadcast mode first requires OWNER ETH >= 27,000,000 gas * CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI * 1.2 (story 087, audit-33 L-07; budget re-derived by story 095, audit-35 L-10), checked in full by EACH broadcast leg. Owner 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6, Ledger HD m/44'/60'/46'/0/0. BROADCAST ORDER (story 092): (1) npm run initiate-dola-ys-withdrawal:broadcast (starts the minter's 6h + 72h totalWithdrawal clock on the autoDOLA strategy; nothing moves); (2) wait at least 6 hours, then npm run dola-ys-withdrawal:status must say 'EXECUTABLE - cutover may START (>6h left)' (story 097; not 'too late to START', not PAUSED); (3) npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:preview and read it (GLOBAL_PAUSE stages incl. after-phase3b and after-phase6b, loss-gate lines, ETH_BUDGET line), top up OWNER if ETH_BUDGET says SHORTFALL, then npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:broadcast (LEG 1: ends after the minter execute; its patch tail stops with deploymentStatus awaiting_reseed - expected), then after the execute mines npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:preview + npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:broadcast again (LEG 2), which chains patch -> :verify -> :preview - all INSIDE the execution window: Phase 0 refuses to start unless initiatedAt + 6h <= now < initiatedAt + 78h - WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN (6h). RE-INITIATE PATH: if the window lapses before the minter step executes (a slow or halted session, or a global pause - totalWithdrawal is whenNotPaused), wait until initiatedAt + 78h has passed (dola-ys-withdrawal:status says expired), rerun step 1, wait 6h again, then resume with :preview and :broadcast; every completed step is state-gated and skips. STORY 096 (audit-35 L-11) - LAPSED WINDOW AFTER PHASE 6: if the halt came after Phase 6 (every V1 staker already migrated into the still-PAUSED V2), do NOT wait out the re-initiate before resuming: resume right away with :preview + :broadcast. Phase 0 then defers Phase 6b instead of reverting: 6b step (a) runs (minter DOLA config recorded, DOLA minting DISABLED), Phase 7 UNPAUSES and registers V2 so stakers can withdraw, and the run ends with progress status awaiting_minter_window (never completed). V2 is unpaused on that resume, but 6b and DOLA minting stay pending until the re-initiated window opens: the minter's DOLA collateral stays on the autoDOLA strategy, V2 autoAnnihilate(DOLA) reverts, and the :broadcast tail stops at :verify by design: that :verify is the one that checks the per-user credits against LIVE V2 balances (V2 has only just gone live) and all other phases, then fails with 'verify: Phase6b: PENDING' - read its message, any OTHER verify failure on that FIRST pending-state :verify is real. CAVEAT: while 6b is pending every :verify still runs the live V2 userInfo >= credited and per-pool V2 totalStaked >= floor checks, so a LATER pending-state :verify (e.g. the one chained after a second pending resume during the 6h re-initiate wait) can fail on a per-user (or per-pool) check instead of reaching 'Phase6b: PENDING' once a migrated staker has withdrawn - that is organic V2 activity, NOT a real failure, and the verifier still refuses the pending state either way. The run records minterMove.v2LiveBeforeMinterMove in the progress file. Then re-initiate (step 1), wait 6h, and run :preview + :broadcast again (leg 1 executes, leg 2 re-seeds, repoints, restores DOLA minting, repoints SYA, retires the source) - after that :verify passes: because V2 was live for 6h+ before 6b completed (stakers may have withdrawn), it skips only the live V2 userInfo >= credited and per-pool V2 totalStaked >= floor comparisons (already checked by the pending-state :verify) and still enforces every event-based credit check and the full 6b block. A FRESH session (V1 not yet drained) with a lapsed window still hard-fails Phase 0.

variantComments.preview: Dry run against LIVE mainnet: impersonates OWNER, signs nothing, broadcasts nothing, NEVER writes the progress file (preview CREATE addresses are fork-local fiction). It READS server/deployments/progress.stable-staker-v2-cutover.1.json when present. PREVIEW IS NOT THE POST-BROADCAST VERIFICATION (story 086, audit L-02): every phase is 'if (!done) do();' under an OWNER prank, so a step that never landed on mainnet is silently PERFORMED in the simulation and Phase 8 then asserts the simulated state (fork-proven: preview passes with V1's phUSD mint still live, with V2 still paused, with V1 registered and unpaused). Its two roles are the PRE-broadcast rehearsal and, AFTER stable-staker-v2-cutover:verify has passed, a smoke test of the live contracts. Smoke tests (prank only): the user-mandated Antimatter mint-revocation proof (throwaway minter approved -> mints -> revoked -> mint reverts; V2 revoked -> mint reverts -> re-approved), a 100-unit stake/withdraw on every V2 pool, and a 1000 DOLA stake + 10-minute warp + autoAnnihilate that must pay phUSD (a longer warp trips Tokemak's Chainlink staleness inside autoDOLA, not our wiring).
variantComments.broadcast: LIVE BROADCAST. PREREQUISITE (story 092): initiate-dola-ys-withdrawal:broadcast landed at least 6h earlier and its execution window has more than 6h left (Phase 0 refuses otherwise). Backs up mainnet-addresses.ts, runs the cutover on the Ledger, then the MANDATORY '&&' tail: patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js FILLS the StableStakerV2 and Antimatter zero placeholders from the progress file, OVERWRITES YieldStrategyDola from 0x1760E05356Ec1FBBA159C730781dCfB9920524e2 to the sDOLA strategy (contracts.ERC4626YieldStrategySDOLA; only when it is exactly 0x1760..., SAME when already patched, else COLLIDE exit 4), FILLS YieldStrategyDolaLegacy with 0x1760... and confirms SDOLA (refuses unless deploymentStatus is completed; same-address is success so a resume leg is idempotent; key-set drift guard exit 3) then chains to :verify (story 086 - the read-only verifier that requires every phase's done-condition from live chain state and never performs a step) and only then to :preview as a smoke test of the live contracts. '&&' not ';' - patching after a failed forge run would write addresses that may not exist. TWO LEGS (story 094, audit-35 L-09): the first run that executes the minter's DOLA totalWithdrawal ENDS AFTER THAT EXECUTE (forge exits 0, progress status awaiting_reseed) and the patch tail then STOPS LOUDLY on purpose (exit 2, 'LEG 1 ENDED AFTER THE MINTER EXECUTE ...'), so :verify / :preview do not run on a half-finished cutover; once the execute has mined run :preview and this key again - leg 2 reads the mined R, re-seeds it, finishes, and the tail patches, verifies (incl. OWNER DOLA residual == pre-execution balance and the minter's sDOLA principal bounded against the execute's DOLA Transfer log) and previews. --legacy and --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 are the story-071/073 lessons carried from promotion-ready (EIP-1559 maxFee dips below base fee in a long --slow Ledger session; per-block accrual makes depositFor cost more than the single-timestamp estimate). GAS PRICE (story 087, audit-33 L-07): one env var, CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI (default 300000000 = 0.3 gwei), is exported and fed BOTH to forge --with-gas-price and to the script; base fee was ~0.16 gwei at planning - re-check before signing and override with e.g. CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI=350000000 npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:broadcast. ETH BUDGET (story 095, audit-35 L-10): the audit-35 anvil rehearsal (fork block 25990689, V1 stakers DOLA 9 / USDC 13 / USDe 7) was 67 transactions before story 094's leg split, 22,982,701 gasUsed; the node checks balance >= gasLimit * price UPFRONT per tx under the 200 multiplier, so the binding figure is max over txs of (cumulative gasUsed before the tx + its signed limit) = 25,163,101 at the USDe migrate (42nd tx, limit 6,706,846), budgeted at 27,000,000 gas; the script REFUSES TO START unless OWNER holds 27,000,000 * price * 12/10 wei = 0.00972 ETH at 0.3 gwei, 0.01134 ETH at 0.35 gwei. Since story 094 the session is 65 txs in two legs (leg 1: 44 txs, ending at the minter execute; leg 2: 21 txs, or up to 23 if OWNER's DOLA allowance to the minter must be re-approved - 22 when it is exactly 0 and a single approve is signed) and EACH leg - and any resume - requires the full budget. Each extra V1 USDe staker adds ~0.77M gas to the binding peak, so re-derive if staker counts grow. OWNER has held less than this at recent audit blocks: TOP UP OWNER BEFORE SIGNING; :preview prints ETH_BUDGET|OK or ETH_BUDGET|SHORTFALL. Without this, forge sends transactions one by one and halts mid-Phase 6 on -32003 insufficient funds. RESUME: the progress file is written in forge's LOCAL pass before sending, so after a crash it can name a contract that never landed - trim it to on-chain-confirmed deployments (run-latest.json receipts + cast nonce), keep the baselines block verbatim, run :preview, then re-run this key; every step is state-gated and the migration re-plans from live V1 state. The script aborts on any recorded address with no code. GLOBAL PAUSE (stories 084 + 087, audit L-04 / audit-33 L-05): the permissionless EYE-burn Pauser.pause() loops every registrant with no try/catch, so ONE registrant that is paused or not pausable by the Pauser pauses nothing. The rule is applied on both sides: Phase 1 retires V1 as setPauser(OWNER) -> Pauser.unregister(V1) -> pause() (unregister BEFORE pause), and Phase 7 does V2 setPauser(Pauser) -> unpause -> Pauser.register(V2) (unpause BEFORE register). The breaker (Pauser.pause() not reverting) is live for the whole session EXCEPT TWO forced one-tx DEAD WINDOWS, because unregister requires the registrant's pauser to have left the Pauser and a registrant whose pauser is OWNER makes the global pause revert: (1) Phase 1, between V1.setPauser(OWNER) and Pauser.unregister(V1) (leg 1 txs 1 -> 2) - remedy: resume, or OWNER calls Pauser.unregister(V1); (2) Phase 6b (story 092), between the autoDOLA strategy 0x1760E05356Ec1FBBA159C730781dCfB9920524e2 setPauser(OWNER) and Pauser.unregister(0x1760...) (leg 2 txs 11 -> 12, or with a re-approve 12 -> 13 when the allowance is exactly 0 or 13 -> 14 when a non-zero allowance is zeroed first) - REMEDY FIRST: OWNER calls Pauser.unregister(0x1760E05356Ec1FBBA159C730781dCfB9920524e2); a :preview on the un-remedied halt reverts globalPause(phase0). Never walk away from a halt in either window. Every other halt point keeps the breaker from reverting and converges on resume, BUT Phase 7 has two one-tx COVERAGE GAPS (story 088, audit-34 Q-04) where the global pause SUCCEEDS while MISSING one contract that is unpaused, pauser already Pauser, unregistered: V2 between its unpause and Pauser.register(V2), and Antimatter between its setPauser(Pauser) and Pauser.register(Antimatter). V2 exposes nothing there (every strategy it routes through is Pauser-registered and every V2 user action reverts under a strategy pause); Antimatter's pause gates only annihilate. REMEDY at a gap: OWNER calling pause() directly REVERTS (onlyPauser) - run setPauser(OWNER) then pause() on that contract, or OWNER Pauser.register(<contract>) then the global pause; after setPauser(OWNER) on V2 a resume re-runs Phase 7 and UNPAUSES V2, so do not resume until the incident is cleared. Preview proves the breaker with a snapshot-isolated EYE-funded Pauser.pause() at phase0 and STRICTLY after every phase (GLOBAL_PAUSE|phase0, |after-phase1, |after-phase2 ... |after-phase8 ... |SUCCEEDED); fork tests probe it after every pause-state transaction; Phase 8 in both modes sweeps every Pauser registrant for unpaused + pauser == Pauser.
variantComments.verify: Story 086 (audit L-02) - READ-ONLY POST-BROADCAST VERIFIER (script/VerifyStableStakerV2Cutover.s.sol). No --broadcast, no --sender, no prank/deal/warp: it reads LIVE mainnet over RPC and never performs a step. For each cutover phase 1-7 it require()s the phase's done-condition from on-chain state - using the same done predicates as the cutover's own phase gates - and fails with 'verify: <phase>: <step> not on chain' naming the FIRST missing step (so before the cutover is broadcast it fails at Phase 1). The progress file supplies ONLY addresses (each must have code), the persisted phUSD minter baseline and baselines.cutoverStartBlock; its status field is never trusted. Checks: V1 retirement triple; V1 phUSD mint revoked; V2 + Antimatter pauser == Pauser and registered, V2 unpaused, claimEnabled false; Antimatter minter set exactly {V2} and the two-sided phUSD minter delta; per token V1 pool Migrating, live re-plan shows ZERO migratable V1 stakers (a V1 stake that raced the Phase-1 pause reverts naming the user, amount and remediation: re-grant the V1 phUSD mint, migrate them, revoke again), stragglers under the 1-cent cap, V2 pool configured, buffer recipient == V2, the exit-realization bound on V1's immutable migrationInfo (story 087, audit-33 L-06; replaces story 085's floor, which false-failed on a V1.userMigrate self-exit); per (token, user) every V1 MigratedOut with non-zero credit - excluding self-exits, identified by UserMigrated - has a V2 DepositedFor within the strategy loss bound and V2 userInfo >= credited; per pool, V2 booked total >= (P - stragglers - self-exited principal rebuilt from UserMigrated credits, rounded up) * (1 - bps) - 1000 wei per migrated user (logs via vm.eth_getLogs from the cutover start block in 5000-block windows; CUTOVER_START_BLOCK env overrides); then story 084's registrant sweep and the full Phase 8 wiring assertions. RUN IT IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BROADCAST (the :broadcast key chains it): the per-pool aggregate and userInfo checks read live V2 balances, which later organic withdrawals can legitimately lower.
